faqs.q: What is a procurement management system?
faqs.a: A procurement management system is software that manages the purchasing of goods and services, from purchase request, approval, and vendor selection to purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice matching, in one recorded flow.

faqs.q: How is this different from SaaS procurement software?
faqs.a: SaaS is quicker to start, but your approval flow and purchasing policy have to fit the features on offer, and licenses are billed per user every month. A custom system follows your process, you own the source code, and there are no per-user license fees.

faqs.q: Can it integrate with our existing accounting system or ERP?
faqs.a: Yes. We integrate through APIs or database connections, for example with Accurate, Jurnal, inventory systems, or an ERP you already run. We confirm the integration details during discovery.

faqs.q: Can vendors access the system to submit quotes?
faqs.a: Yes, if you need it. A vendor portal lets vendors submit quotes, confirm POs, and upload invoices themselves, so purchasing no longer has to collect them from email.

faqs.q: How long does it take to build?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of modules, the complexity of the approval flow, and integrations. After discovery we give you a written timeline and cost estimate before development starts.

faqs.q: How much does it cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on scope, not a fixed package. You can get a first indication from the calculator on the Pricing page, and we prepare a written quotation after the discovery session.

faqs.q: What is the difference between online ERP and on-premise ERP?
faqs.a: Online ERP runs in the cloud and is used through a browser, so teams in the office, warehouse, and branches work with the same data in real time. On-premise ERP is installed on an office server and is usually harder to reach from outside.

faqs.q: Why choose a custom online ERP over SaaS ERP?
faqs.a: SaaS ERP suits standard processes. If your workflow is specific, your team keeps growing, or you want full ownership of the source code and data, a custom ERP is usually cheaper over time and does not force your team to change how it works.

faqs.q: Is our data safe in the cloud?
faqs.a: We apply role-based access, encrypted connections, regular backups, and audit logs. You can also choose to host in your company's own cloud account.

faqs.q: Can we start with one module?
faqs.a: Yes, and that is what we recommend. Start with the most urgent module, such as inventory or sales, then add the next one once the team is comfortable.

faqs.q: Can it connect to the apps we already use?
faqs.a: Yes. The ERP can integrate with accounting software, marketplaces, POS, or payment gateways through APIs.

faqs.q: What is a recruitment management system?
faqs.a: A recruitment management system is software that manages hiring from the moment an opening is published until a candidate accepts, including applications, screening, interviews, scoring, and offers.

faqs.q: How is this different from HRIS software?
faqs.a: HRIS manages people who have already joined, such as employee records, leave, and payroll. A recruitment management system covers the process before a candidate becomes an employee. The two can be connected so accepted candidates flow straight into your HRIS.

faqs.q: Can candidates apply directly through our website?
faqs.a: Yes. We can build a careers page and application form connected straight to the pipeline, so applications never need to be re-entered.

faqs.q: What about candidate data security?
faqs.a: Candidate data is personal data. We design the system with role-based access, an audit trail, and data retention settings to support your company's compliance with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law.

faqs.q: Can AI be used to screen CVs?

portfolio.name: Marketing Agency Software
portfolio.description: Perangkat lunak khusus untuk mengelola berbagai kebutuhan pemasaran digital, seperti pembuatan marketing funnels, otomatisasi email, pengelolaan formulir prospek (lead forms), dan berbagai fitur optimasi kampanye lainnya.
portfolio.description_en: Specialized software for managing various digital marketing needs, such as creating marketing funnels, email automation, lead form management, and various other campaign optimization features.

portfolio.description: Perangkat lunak pendukung hukum otomotif yang menyederhanakan manajemen kasus, mengotomatisasi pemrosesan dokumen, serta meningkatkan pelacakan klaim untuk memberikan respon hukum yang lebih cepat.

portfolio.name: Flexavi
portfolio.description: Sistem manajemen operasional untuk layanan perbaikan atap yang mengintegrasikan pemantauan armada teknisi, otomatisasi penagihan, dan pengaturan jadwal janji temu pelanggan dalam satu platform terpadu.

portfolio.description: Situs web profesional untuk spesialis perbaikan atap yang menawarkan solusi komprehensif bagi atap bermasalah, termasuk layanan penggantian atap baru dengan berbagai pilihan material dan sistem isolasi yang efisien.
portfolio.description_en: A professional website for roofing repair specialists, offering comprehensive solutions for problematic roofs, including new roof replacement services with various material options and efficient insulation systems.

portfolio.name: Body Gravity
portfolio.description: Situs profil perusahaan untuk pionir sistem terapi gerak terintegrasi yang berfokus pada pemulihan dan maksimalisasi fungsi tubuh tanpa bantuan alat medis, tindakan bedah, maupun konsumsi obat-obatan.
portfolio.description_en: A company profile site for integrated motion therapy system pioneers focused on restoring and maximizing body function without the aid of medical devices, surgical procedures, or medication.

portfolio.name: DSH Dakdekkers
portfolio.description: Situs web profil perusahaan spesialis perbaikan atap bermasalah yang menawarkan solusi penggantian atap baru dengan berbagai pilihan layanan teknis yang komprehensif dan terpercaya.
portfolio.description_en: A company profile website for a roof repair specialist that offers new roof replacement solutions with a variety of comprehensive and reliable technical services.

portfolio.name: Berita Kripto Terpercaya

portfolio.description_en: A news portal and blog media website that provides the latest information, market reports, and education about the world of Crypto and gold accurately and reliably for investors.

portfolio.name: Butonas Petrochemical Indonesia
portfolio.description: Situs profil perusahaan untuk proyek pembangunan pabrik metanol terbesar di Indonesia yang berlokasi di Bojonegoro. Website ini menampilkan informasi strategis mengenai penggunaan teknologi AirLiquide dan kolaborasi dengan perusahaan EPC kelas dunia dalam pengelolaan sumber daya gas alam.

This website showcases strategic information regarding the use of AirLiquide technology and collaboration with world-class EPC companies in natural gas resource management.

portfolio.description_en: A lead generation website designed to find digital marketing leads, equipped with analytics and statistics features to help users accurately analyze lead data progress.

portfolio.name: Dak Perfect
portfolio.description: Perangkat lunak analisis manajemen yang berfungsi untuk menghitung dan melacak progres KPI karyawan secara otomatis guna meningkatkan transparansi kinerja perusahaan.
